deviations.what: First sap.f port. Static ShellBar with a sap.m Menu and a profile Avatar; the homeIcon points at the OpenUI5 host (https://sdk.openui5.org/resources/sap/ui/documentation/sdk/images/logo_sap.png) per the asset-URL rule; the original uses the relative ./resources/... path. No controller events are wired in the original view (the controller's handleHomeIconPress is unreferenced there too).

sap.m.Avatar (control @since 1.73) is used 1:1 as the profile avatar (m:Avatar initials='UI'). Newer than UI5 1.71; declared per the property-171 policy (app 152 precedent, same ShellBar profile Avatar), so the app needs UI5 >= 1.73 to render the avatar. Added at the 2026-07-27 review sweep - the control-level @since is invisible to the member-level property gate.
